avis.titre: A Fantastic Addition To My Skin Care Routine!  A Must Have For Mature Dry Sensitive Skin!A Fantastic Addition To My Skin
avis.texte: The I'm From Mugwort line is one of the best skin care lines I have ever used. My skin loves the mugwort products. I have mature (age 60) dry sensitive skin. I have been using a toner on my face, neck, and upper chest area daily, and wanted to try an essence product to rotate in with my toner. This Mugwort Essence is beyond fantastic for my skin over my entire body, including my scalp! - Application: I empty a small amount in the palm of my hand, then pat it on my face, neck, upper chest, and anywhere else on my body where my skin needs some TLC. It absorbs into your skin rapidly. Don't squeeze the bottle, as the product is very liquidy. I just shake the bottle a bit and the product comes out. - This essence can be used as a replacement for your toner, or layered along with your toner. - I have been amazed at how beneficial this essence has been for my scalp and hair care. My scalp is much less dry and irritate since I began using this essence on my scalp and very short pixie style hair. - This essence has a warming effect on my skin as my circulation improves. My skin has more color, and is soft and more plump. - This essence is a bit more expensive than some other skin care products, but in my opinion the fantastic results I experience make this product a terrific value. I highly recommend this Mugwort Essence product.

I've probably been through at least 10 bottles of the I'm From Mugwort Essence at this point. Out of all the skincare products, this is the one product I will always recommend to everyone around me. It's incredibly calming and soothing, and it's great for all skin types. Ever since I started using it, my skin has become noticeably less red, and I rarely ever break out anymore. I use it every morning and night after toner, and my skin drinks it up. Mugwort is also known for it's healing properties, so this is great for anyone with acne or acne scarring. This is truly a product that does it all; if you're someone who struggles with dryness, oil, acne, and/or sensitive skin, this is a must-have for you. I have severely sensitive skin, and this is one of the only products that have been able to get rid of my redness and calm it down. I cannot recommend this enough!!!
This is my second bottle of this essence. It's soothing and hydrating on my combo/oily skin and doesn't cause any breakouts. It helps calm any redness and helped to heal my skin barrier.

avis.titre: Mugwort essence, light brown liquid with herbal sent.Mugwort essence, light brown liquid with herbal sent.
avis.texte: This toner came in a tall, plastic bottle and it is easy to use. I usually apply it on a cotton round and than wipe my face. Watery texture absorbs quickly into the skin, but it is a little bit sticky. I am using it at the evening, but it is also suitable for the morning routines. The ad description said "Crafted with a single plant-based ingredient", but there are a lot of other ingredients in the ingredients list. So, maybe some older formula had a less ingredients, but this one have much more. Water, Artemisia Princeps Extract, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ethyl hexylglycerin, Propanediol, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate. It is slightly sticky when apply, but it quickly absorbs. The benefits of mugwort extract are expected to have hydrating and calming effect. The color is light brown and the scent is herbal and light. I do not notice any special benefits after applying, but don't have any irritation either.

I’ve been fully influenced by the whole “skin flooding” thing and since I tend to be sensitive and have rosacea this works well to keep me hydrated and blemish free. Just a great toner that I’ve included in my skin care routine to keep my 45+ year old a** looking decent.
I absolutely love the I’m From products. This did not feel greasy. It left my skin hydrated, glowing and soft. There was no frangrance to it.
Calming and lightweight essence. Definitely great for my acne prone, sensitive

I like to layer toners/essences and this one feels good. I use multiple toners/essences in my routine and have only used this one for a few weeks so I don’t think I can say whether it’s making a difference or not.

avis.titre: さっぱり使えるヨモギエッセンス化粧水
avis.texte: 肌のコンディションを整えたくて、こちらを選びました。 ヨモギエキス配合で、敏感肌にも使いやすそうな点に魅力を感じました。 実際に使ってみると、さらっとしたテクスチャーで肌になじみやすく、ベタつきが気になりません。 さっぱりとした使用感なので、朝晩どちらのスキンケアにも取り入れやすいです。 保湿感もほどよくあり、肌をやさしくうるおしてくれます。 季節を問わず使いやすく、他のスキンケアとも組み合わせやすいと感じました。 乾燥が強い時期には、この化粧水だけでは保湿が物足りなく感じることもあるため、美容液やクリームと併用するとより使いやすいと思います。 全体的にみて、使いやすさ・肌なじみ・さっぱりとした使用感のバランスが良く、肌をすこやかに整えたい方におすすめできる化粧水でした。

avis.titre: ヨモギの香りでしっとり潤う敏感肌にも優しい化粧水です。ヨモギの香りでしっとり潤う敏感肌にも優しい化粧水です。
avis.texte: 商品名 I'm from マグワートエッセンス 150ml 化粧水 スキン トナー ヨモギ 植物性ヴィーガン 鎮静 保湿 敏感肌ケア 商品説明 ヨモギエキス（整肌・保湿）を配合した、毎日のコンディションケアに使いやすいエッセンスです。 配合成分は「水、ヨモギエキス、1,2-ヘキサンジオール」のシンプル設計で、肌をすこやかに整えます。 アルコールフリー、無香料（香料・精油不使用）の表記があり、香りが気になる方にも配慮されています。 みずみずしい使用感で、肌になじませやすく、うるおいを与えて整えます（使用感には個人差があります）。 使い方：洗顔後、化粧水で肌を整えた後に適量を手に取り、顔全体へやさしくなじませてください。 気になる部分は重ねづけも可能。肌状態に合わせて量・回数を調整してください。 レビュー 【敏感肌チェック】○ つけたて：刺激なし 数日後：刺激なし ねじってあけるタイプの製品です。このタイプの化粧水少し面倒なんですよね。蓋を置いて、化粧水出して塗って、また蓋を閉める。ワンタップで開けれるタイプの蓋の方が好きです。 手の甲に広げるとサラッと水のようなテクスチャーでスーッと肌に浸透していきました。 香りはお屠蘇のようなヨモギのような。ヨモギ餅の香りより、ヨモギ茶の香りに近い感じです。薬草っぽい感じが苦手な方は少し気になるかもしれないですね。 手の平に出すと茶色っぽい色合いなのがわかりました。 顔に塗り広げると水よりも少しとろみがある感覚でそれでも一瞬で浸透してしまいます。つけてもしみたり赤くなったりもせず敏感肌に優しい使い心地。そして一度塗ったら十分に潤うので、何度も重ね付けしなくて良いのが忙しい朝疲れ切った夜とても楽でした。 ベタベタしないのでスキンケアが苦手な方にも良いと思います。 ヨモギは敏感肌には刺激があるかな？と1ヶ月近く使用しましたが荒れることはありませんでした。 使っているうちにキャップの周りに溜まり、溝のところに色がついてくるのが少し気になりました。こまめに拭く必要があります。

I love this product! It’s very hydrating and plays nicely with my actives like retinal. Layers really nicely under my moisturizer and sunscreen. I am on my third bottle! However, they changed the packaging (which is totally fine), but they claimed the “volume remains unchanged.” This seems a little fishy after seeing the new bottle next to my old bottle. Both bottles have very similar footprints but the new bottle is significantly shorter. Turns out the old bottles hold 5.41 fl oz while the new ones only hold 5.07 fl oz. This may not seem like a lot, but I am wondering if we are paying the same amount for less product.

My skincare routine was already in decent shape — cleanser, toner, moisturizer, SPF — but I'd been reading about essences and how they fit into a Korean skincare routine as a calming, prep layer between toner and everything else. Mugwort kept coming up as an ingredient worth trying for combination skin that runs reactive in the T-zone, so I added this one to see if it actually made a difference or just added another step for the sake of it. The texture is closer to water than anything else — thin, slightly fluid, absorbs almost immediately with no residue. I pat a small amount onto my face after toner and it disappears within seconds, which matters when you're layering products and don't want everything sitting heavy on top of each other. There's a faint herbal scent that's noticeable when you first apply it but doesn't linger past the first minute or so. It's not unpleasant, just distinctly botanical — worth knowing about if you prefer completely fragrance-free products. The calming effect is the most noticeable thing for me. My skin tends to run a little red and reactive around the nose and chin, especially after cleansing, and that general irritability has settled down since adding this to my routine. It's hard to isolate one product in a multi-step routine with complete certainty, but the improvement has been consistent enough that it seems like more than coincidence. My skin just feels more settled day to day — less reactive to weather changes, less tight in the drier ar

avis.titre: A Simple Effective Product I Can Rely On
avis.texte: Finding a product that's truly soothing and non-irritating makes a world of difference when skin feels reactive. This essence is one of those that works for my skin in any situation, focused entirely on a single plant-based ingredient to calm and soothe. It's one of those products that's perfect for when I'm rushed for time and don't want to think about what I need to focus on for my skincare needs. I can just grab this knowing it's going to work for me no matter what. APPLICATION AND TEXTURE: The essence is incredibly lightweight and feels refreshing the moment it's applied. It isn't greasy, so it's a reliable choice for both morning and night. The watery texture absorbs almost instantly without any stickiness, making it very easy to layer under other serums and creams. It has a very distinct herbal scent that you have to get used to, but it's just natural and doesn't linger. RESULTS: Because it's naturally antibacterial, it helps regulate oil glands and targets congestion and enlarged pores in my T-zone and inner cheeks without drying out the rest of my face. It's excellent for addressing dullness and uneven tone because it provides a gentle antioxidant boost that brightens the complexion but without causing irritation. It's a straightforward, effective product that provides exactly the kind of hydration and peace my skin needs during a flare up. It can also be applied to cotton rounds and used as a quick 10 minute mask to calm and soothe irritated skin. This is a fantastic

This is a Korean made toner that focuses on mugwort essence. While mugwort is the focus it is not a plain essence. There were a few other ingredients, probably as a carrier liquid. I think this toner might be a good value if you need to focus on the benefits of mugwort. Mugwort is supposedly good for sensitive skin as well as longterm conditions like eczema. If you have a skin condition, mugwort is worth trying. For myself I have average skin but as a retinol user I experience flakiness and redness from my retinol use. The mugwort did help calm my skin but I have had similar benefits from toners with cica or centella. It was effective in reducing redness for me but so are other essences. Mugwort is not a "must have" ingredient for me but it might be for others. One star off because this toner had a sticky feeling. I have some sensory issues so I might stick with more lighweight toners that dry faster. I could feel this toner as a layer on my face. I usually use this toner at night when I have time for it to absorb and then the residual feeling is less bothersome than it would be in the morning when I am rushing to apply makeup. Some people do a routine where they apply multiple layers of toner to intentionally create this kind of moist residue. For them, the texture might be ideal. I just prefer a lighter toner I can splash on that absorbs faster. This toner is moisturizing and I like it as a pre-treatment before my nightly retinol. It seems to ameliorate the dryness and stin

avis.titre: Excellent calming product for sensitive or irritated skin
avis.texte: The product has been a great addition to my routine, especially on days when my skin feels irritated or reactive. The texture is very lightweight - almost like water. But it delivers noticeable hydration and a calming effect right away. I use this after cleansing and before serums, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any residue. It layers well and never feels heavy or greasy. What really stands out is how soothing it is. Redness and sensitivity seem less noticeable after consistent use, and my skin feels more balanced overall. There’s no strong fragrance, which I appreciate, and it hasn’t caused any breakouts or irritation. This feels like a simple, focused product that does exactly what it’s meant to do, which is to calm and hydrate the skin without unnecessary extras. If you have sensitive, acne-prone, or easily irritated skin, this product is definitely worth trying. It’s gentle, effective, and easy to incorporate into both morning and nighttime routines. By the way, the packaging wasnt the greatest. It got beat a bit during shipping.

This is my first time using product made by I’m From. Also curious about what the Mugwort Essence will do for my dry skin. Try it for few days already and feel it is a good product for me. First, I like the bottle design, the hole just enough for the liquid coming out but not too much so you can just use dots by dots for whatever you want which is very easy to applied. Second, the essence is so light and calming for my skin. It absolutely does moisturize my skin. It absorbs super quickly and not oily at all. Over all, I like to use it right after washing my face. And this essence left me a clean and moist feeling. Over all, for few days using no itchy or sticky feeling. My skin type is dry so I applied twice every time. The smell is hardly noticeable and quite pleasant just a natural sensation of plant. Try it if you light a light weight skin care.

This is a Korean made skin care product. They are usually know for the their quality and usefulness. The particular product is used similar to a toner. It can help calm sensitive skin and then help that skin absorb other products better. It is 150ml of product. It is not a moisturizer but can help prep the skin to absorb moisture better. It is not fragrance free. Directions say that it can be used like a toner, or as a mask with soaked cotton balls for 5 minutes. My assumption is the mask for for the calming part and the patting on is for toner properties.

avis.titre: Soothing hydration to calm your moody skin
avis.texte: Nearing 50, and my years of skin neglect plus sun exposure are starting to catch up with me. To top it off I live in a dry, high altitude climate where the sun is strong and weather changes on a dime. Moisturizing without oil is key and this mugwort essence absorbs BEAUTIFULLY on those days that my skin needs to his calm down. It’s calming and gives me a glow without making me look shiny. The texture of my skin is smooth, not sticky, there’s no stinging, and it doesn’t pill at all when combined with other products. It manages to actually control excess oil without drying, too, which means it will be perfect for layering under tinted sunscreen this summer. I would say it’s highly effective for my skin and it has the faintest herbal scent. I’ve tried a few products now from this brand and im a huge fan, would highly recommend! For the effectiveness combined with what feels like luxe packaging, I would say the “I’m From” line is a great value and worth checking out.

Mugwort Korean skin care essence is perfect for sensitive dry skin. I have a hard time finding products for my super sensitive and dry skin so I was excited to try this product and I'm so happy i did. The texture is liquid like water and it does have a musky type of scent. It hydrates and leaves my skin smooth and I love it absorbs fast. It has really helped me with my flaky skin and i love that it's long lasting. I didn't get no irritation or discomfort and the bottle is a decent size 5.07oz.

​I have integrated this mugwort essence into my daily routine for quite some time, and it has become an essential solution for my chronic dry skin. Its greatest strength is how effectively it helps my skin retain moisture post-cleansing, acting as the perfect preparatory layer. ​The formula is incredibly lightweight and soothing on the skin. Because you only need a small amount to see results, a single bottle lasts for months, making it an excellent value. It layers seamlessly with the rest of my skincare products without any pilling or heaviness. If you are looking for a gentle, effective essence that preps the skin and enhances hydration, this is a fantastic choice.

avis.titre: Gentle, hydrating and lightweight Mugwort essence.
avis.texte: I love skincare, and recently have tried other products by this brand. I was really excited to try out this 'I'm From' Mugwort Essence. This product came nicely presented, and I like that this product was sealed on the inside (especially when dealing with skincare products). I was impressed with the size of the bottle, as well as a little bit going a long ways. This product is an essence that feels like a lightweight serum, in my experience. It absorbs very well onto my skin, and feels soothing and hydrating. I like that it feels moisturizing, but doesn't feel heavy nor does it pill when used with other skincare (or makeup) products. This essence has been very gentle to my skin, while still delivering on moisture and softness. I feel that it has been very useful and helpful for my skincare needs, and can also be used with other products. There's not much of a scent to this, to those who may be concerned about fragrances. I really like this Mugwort Essence, and feel that it's been very good for my skincare concerns. I like that I can use a little bit at a time, and get a nice effect; I think this will last me for a while. Overall, I think this is an excellent quality product and at a nice value (in my personal opinion).

avis.titre: Hydrating Essence That Softens Dry, Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I picked up this essence to target a few dry areas on my face, and it’s been a great addition to my routine. It has a light, natural scent and a pale beige color. The texture is slightly thicker than typical essences, which makes it easy to apply and helps it glide smoothly onto the skin. I have mature, sensitive skin, and it absorbs well without irritation. After using it, my dry areas feel noticeably softer and more hydrated. Since you only need a small amount each time, the large bottle will last quite a while—making it an excellent value.

My wife has added these two products from "I'm From" to her skin care regiment and is loving them.. This one helps with oily skin so well.. To the point she is making me start using it now. Highly recommend this product for oily skin!

avis.titre: former holy grail; reformulated and inferior to the original; SO diappointed; get the Tosowoong
avis.texte: Update 07/2026: The TOSOWOONG Mugwort Booster Serum just came out and has almost the exact ingredient list and formula of the OG version of this essence. Get that instead! I'm From makes so many of my ride or die products and unfortunately for me, this was one of them. I was so sad to see their rebrand with the new font (I don't like it; it's tacky) as well as the switch from the elegant and upscale minimalist glass bottles to these cheap plastic ones. Double thumbs down to both of these changes, which make the brand and the products both seem cheap, generic, and super low-effort. I wouldn't even recognize these as I'm From if I saw them on the shelf, and I wouldn't feel compelled to buy them, either. It's also just shrinkflation masked as rebranding, because several of their beloved masks were also switched to plastic tubes with approximately half the product for the same price. The old formula for this was very simple: Water, Artemisia Princeps Extract, 1,2-Hexanediol. In fact, looking at the reviews, it seems like Japan still got this formulation this month also, just with new packaging. The one I received is reformulated and definitely for the worse: Water, Artemisia Princeps Extract, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Propanediol, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate They watered it down, and they did it to the Rice Toner, too. I try a ton of skincare and I have written before about how MANY of my favorite companies are currently reform
